fieldValues.title: Are the package's meeting and the clerk's session one thing?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Raised by the level design (Research: Protocol evolution, part 6): the acts a person takes on minutes are clerk session acts. No option chosen.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. One type: a session may have a transcript and minutes.
- B. Two types, related: a meeting is what happened; a session is where its outcomes are accepted.
- C. Keep them apart until a group uses both.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Whether the secretary's check happens in the meeting or after it; what a working group's session without a transcript needs.
fieldValues.next_action: Model the first group's next meeting both ways on paper before moving the runner into the clerk.
